answer: A fake identity farm must pay the full bond per node plus earn real nectar from work prior to votes count, so forging N identities costs N bonds with no opal-grade reputation to show. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a bond of lotus tokens to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Attackers lose capital on detection while honest agents recover stakes on exit, making mass identity creation strictly more expensive than genuine participation. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
